events.name: Tavern Brawl
events.description: You enter a tavern for a drink. A surly dwarf takes offense at your presence and throws a mug at your head!

success.description: You knock the dwarf flat. The tavern cheers! Free drinks for the rest of the night.

failure.description: The dwarf is surprisingly strong. You end up face-first on the floor.

success.description: You buy the dwarf a drink and end up hearing an interesting rumor about a nearby dungeon.

failure.description: Your words only make the dwarf angrier. You leave quickly.

choices.description: You dodge the mug and slip out. Not worth the trouble.

events.name: Town Market
events.description: The town's marketplace bustles with activity. Merchants call out their wares from colorful stalls.

events.name: Temple Healer
events.description: A kindly cleric at the local temple offers healing to weary travelers.

choices.description: The cleric lays hands on you and warm light flows through your body.
The cleric performs a thorough healing ritual. All wounds and ailments are cured.

events.name: Pickpocket!
events.description: A nimble street urchin bumps into you. Wait — where's your coin purse?!

success.description: You catch the urchin's hand in your pocket. They squirm free and flee.

failure.description: By the time you notice, the urchin is gone — along with some of your gold!

events.name: Adventurer's Quest Board
events.description: A wooden board covered in notices stands in the town square. One posting catches your eye.

choices.text: Accept the bounty: Clear the goblin camp (combat)

choices.description: You scan the board and learn about the surrounding area.

events.name: Rest at the Inn
events.description: The 'Sleepy Dragon Inn' has a warm fire, soft beds, and hearty stew.

choices.description: You enjoy a peaceful night's rest and a hot breakfast.

choices.text: Pay 10 gold for the luxury suite
choices.description: The finest room in the house! You awake feeling incredible.
